about: Ruling 52's addendum to the second image evaluation: the five new ordinary pictures the gates held as unsure, each released by the owner's tap, as the run recorded it. bench/run_images.py draws bench/IMAGE_EVAL_2026-10-23_released.md from this file alone. Fictional pictures only.

versions.image gate: `StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21` with `--vision` on cpu, strands-decider 0.2.0 in its own venv, 127.0.0.1:8001, the picture question at the text gate's floor (0.60)

versions.scene: the vision server: "What does this picture represent?" over the picture and its OCR text, at the routing read's floor for a choice question (0.70)
versions.release: the owner's tap on the Release button of the hold's notice, in the owner's Telegram chat, read from the bot's updates and recorded by the courier's own release handler
versions.hardware: the build laptop's CPU (16 logical cores), each Decider server capped at 4 threads at below-normal priority; kernels: reference PyTorch implementation (causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention not installed; CPU-only torch build)
versions.conditions: the other long-running experiment on this laptop paused; the laptop otherwise idle; each release by the owner's tap
